sentences.sentence_en: I stayed up all night and still did not finish it well.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我熬了一整夜，最终还是没能把它做好。
sentences.explanation: stay up 表示熬夜；did not 后接动词原形。

sentences.sentence_en: I felt tired and disappointed the next morning.
sentences.sentence_cn: 第二天早上，我感到疲惫又失望。
sentences.explanation: felt 是 feel 的过去式；disappointed 表示失望的。

sentences.sentence_en: My teacher told me that good planning could save time and reduce stress.
sentences.sentence_cn: 老师告诉我，良好的计划可以节省时间、减轻压力。
sentences.explanation: tell somebody that 引导宾语从句；reduce stress 表示减轻压力。

sentences.sentence_en: Since then, I have tried to start important tasks earlier.
sentences.sentence_cn: 从那以后，我努力提前开始重要任务。
sentences.explanation: since then 常与现在完成时连用；earlier 表示更早。

sentences.sentence_en: I learned that small steps can make a big difference.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我明白了，小小的行动也能带来很大的改变。
sentences.explanation: make a difference 表示产生影响、带来改变。

expressions.example: Don't wait until the last minute.
I had to stay up all night.
I felt better the next morning.
Planning ahead can save time.
A little practice can make a big difference.

questions.question: What problem did the writer have?
questions.explanation: 作者拖到太晚才开始重要的学校项目。

questions.question: What did the teacher say good planning could do?
questions.explanation: 老师指出计划能节省时间并减轻压力。

questions.question: The writer now tries to start important tasks earlier.
questions.explanation: 作者从那以后努力提前开始重要任务。

quality_check.grammar: 一般过去时、现在完成时及宾语从句使用正确。
quality_check.american_english: 使用自然的美式英语表达。
quality_check.translation: 中文翻译完整、自然。
quality_check.chunking: 每句分块按原顺序拼接可还原原句。
quality_check.notes: 通过拖延造成的后果引出时间管理的经验。

content_en: My last vacation was in California. I traveled there with my cousin for five days. We stayed in a small hotel near the beach and rented a car to explore the area. Every day, we visited a new place, tried local food, and took pictures. My favorite day was when we walked along the coast and watched the sunset. The trip was relaxing and fun. I came home with many photos and great memories. I hope to visit again someday.
content_cn: 我的上一次假期是在加利福尼亚。我和表亲一起在那里旅行了五天。我们住在海滩附近的一家小旅馆，并租了一辆车探索周边地区。每天，我们都会去一个新的地方，品尝当地美食并拍照。我最喜欢的一天是沿着海岸散步、欣赏日落的那一天。这次旅行既放松又有趣。我带着许多照片和美好的回忆回到了家。我希望有一天能再次去那里。

sentences.sentence_en: My last vacation was in California.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我的上一次假期是在加利福尼亚。
sentences.explanation: last vacation 表示上一次假期；was 是 be 动词的过去式。

sentences.sentence_en: I traveled there with my cousin for five days.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我和表亲一起在那里旅行了五天。
sentences.explanation: travel with somebody 表示和某人一起旅行；for five days 表示持续五天。

sentences.sentence_en: We stayed in a small hotel near the beach and rented a car to explore the area.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我们住在海滩附近的一家小旅馆，并租了一辆车探索周边地区。
sentences.explanation: stay in a hotel 表示住在旅馆；rent a car 表示租车；to explore 表示目的。

sentences.sentence_en: Every day, we visited a new place, tried local food, and took pictures.
sentences.sentence_cn: 每天，我们都会去一个新的地方，品尝当地美食并拍照。
sentences.explanation: 三个过去式动词并列描述每天的旅行活动。

sentences.sentence_en: My favorite day was when we walked along the coast and watched the sunset.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我最喜欢的一天是沿着海岸散步、欣赏日落的那一天。
sentences.explanation: favorite 表示最喜欢的；along the coast 表示沿着海岸。

sentences.sentence_en: The trip was relaxing and fun.
sentences.sentence_cn: 这次旅行既放松又有趣。
sentences.explanation: relaxing 表示令人放松的；fun 表示有趣的。

sentences.sentence_en: I came home with many photos and great memories.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我带着许多照片和美好的回忆回到了家。
sentences.explanation: come home 表示回家；came 是 come 的过去式。

sentences.sentence_en: I hope to visit again someday.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我希望有一天能再次去那里。
sentences.explanation: hope to do something 表示希望做某事；someday 表示将来的某一天。

questions.explanation: 文章第一句说明假期是在加利福尼亚度过的。

questions.explanation: 作者和表亲在那里旅行了五天。

questions.question: The writer hopes to visit California again.
questions.explanation: 最后一句表达了作者希望有一天再次前往的愿望。

quality_check.grammar: 一般过去时叙述假期经历，并用 hope to do 表达未来愿望。
quality_check.translation: 中文翻译完整、自然。
